faq.q: Can you shoot out tyres to stop a car in GTA VI?
faq.a: Yes. WIRED reports a police chase in the Extended Look shows cars being shot at, with blown tyres causing a car to flip and crash into a sidewalk.

faq.q: Is there visible car damage during chases in GTA VI?
faq.a: Yes, WIRED reports visible environmental destruction alongside the tyre and crash physics shown in the chase sequence.

faq.q: Does GTA VI show close-combat takedowns on police?
faq.a: WIRED reports a character body-slams a cop through a wall in the same section of the video covering shooting and destruction.

faq.q: Where was this damage physics footage shown?
faq.a: It appeared in the Extended Look gameplay video released 27 August 2026, during a police car chase sequence.
